title: Enforce Emoji Style Fe0f Everywhere
description: The emoji system is not consistent. Use plain emojis everywhere. Add a statute to code policy and autofix it by replacing the unicode string with actual plain emojis. Strip things like variation selector (e.g. VS15 / text presentation). Fix the codebase.
